fsm_states_poc.name: DEFAULT_CONFIG
fsm_states_poc.description: Entered after reset / power-up; the Communication Controller is unconfigured.

fsm_states_poc.name: CONFIG
fsm_states_poc.description: The host configures the CC: schedule, slot assignment, timing parameters, sync/coldstart role, CRC initialization.

fsm_states_poc.name: READY
fsm_states_poc.description: Configuration complete; the CC awaits a command to start wakeup or startup.

fsm_states_poc.name: WAKEUP
fsm_states_poc.description: The CC performs the wakeup procedure (transmit/detect the Wakeup Pattern) to wake the channel(s).

fsm_states_poc.name: STARTUP
fsm_states_poc.description: The CC runs coldstart / integration (CAS, startup frames, schedule integration, initial clock synchronization).

fsm_states_poc.name: NORMAL_ACTIVE
fsm_states_poc.description: Fully operational steady state: the node follows the TDMA schedule, sends/receives frames, and contributes to and follows clock synchronization.

fsm_states_poc.name: NORMAL_PASSIVE
fsm_states_poc.description: Degraded synchronization status (e.g. too few sync frames): the node still receives and keeps time but does not actively transmit until it recovers.

fsm_states_poc.name: HALT
fsm_states_poc.description: Communication stopped (fatal error or host halt command); the CC leaves the schedule.

fsm_states_media_access.name: STATIC_SLOT
fsm_states_media_access.description: TDMA: on each static slot the slot owner transmits its frame; the slot counter advances every static slot regardless of whether a frame was sent.

fsm_states_media_access.name: DYNAMIC_MINISLOT
fsm_states_media_access.description: FTDMA: the minislot counter advances; the node whose dynamic Frame ID matches the current minislot may transmit, holding the counter for its frame.

fsm_states_media_access.name: SYMBOL_WINDOW
fsm_states_media_access.description: Optional segment for network-management symbols (CAS / MTS / WUS).

fsm_states_media_access.name: NIT
fsm_states_media_access.description: Network Idle Time: no frames; clock-sync calculation and offset correction applied.

fsm_states_clock_sync.name: MEASURE
fsm_states_clock_sync.description: Measure arrival timing of received sync frames on both channels during the static segment.

fsm_states_clock_sync.name: OFFSET_CORRECTION
fsm_states_clock_sync.description: Compute the phase correction using the Fault-Tolerant Midpoint algorithm; apply it during the NIT for the next cycle.

fsm_states_clock_sync.name: RATE_CORRECTION
fsm_states_clock_sync.description: Compute the frequency correction over an even/odd cycle pair and apply it gradually (microticks per cycle).

fsm_hints.trigger: Reset -> DEFAULT_CONFIG. Host configures (CONFIG) then READY; a start command drives WAKEUP then STARTUP; successful coldstart/integration reaches NORMAL_ACTIVE.
fsm_hints.rule: Only sync frames (sync indicator set, static segment, configured sync nodes) feed clock synchronization; at least two sync nodes and two coldstart nodes are required.
fsm_hints.abort: Insufficient valid sync frames degrade NORMAL_ACTIVE -> NORMAL_PASSIVE -> HALT; a fatal error or host halt forces HALT.

anti_deadlock_rule: The TDMA schedule is collision-free by construction (one configured sender per static slot); the optional Bus Guardian enforces it, preventing a babbling node from holding the bus. The FTDMA minislot counter always advances when a minislot is empty, so the dynamic segment cannot stall.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On reset the CC enters DEFAULT_CONFIG. The host moves it through CONFIG (load schedule/timing/role) to READY, then commands WAKEUP (WUP/WUS) and STARTUP (CAS + startup frames + integration + initial clock sync); once >=2 coldstart nodes agree and synchronization is running the node reaches NORMAL_ACTIVE.

default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_idle: TxEN de-asserted (driver off) outside the node's assigned slot; bus left in the idle/recessive differential state.
default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_active: Assert TxEN and drive TxD only during the assigned static slot or won dynamic minislot.
default_ready_state_recommendation.RX_idle: Continuously sample RxD on both channels; accept frames passing Header and Frame CRC.

configurations.name: Single-channel node
configurations.description: Connected to Channel A or B only.

configurations.name: Dual-channel redundant
configurations.description: Connected to both channels; same frame on A and B for fault tolerance.

configurations.name: Dual-channel bandwidth
configurations.description: Connected to both channels carrying different traffic for doubled bandwidth.

timing_dependency_rule: Every node derives the global time {cycle counter, macrotick} from clock synchronization; all slot and segment boundaries are fixed in macroticks and identical cluster-wide. The macrotick (an integer number of microticks adjusted by rate correction) is the synchronized unit, so slot timing is deterministic across the cluster.
